home_title.en: Go JWT Authentication with Refresh Tokens | go-jwt

en.home: Go JWT authentication library: ES256 JWT tokens, Redis-backed refresh token rotation and revocation, device binding, Gin middleware. By 邱敬幃 Pardn Chiu.
en.getting-started: Install go-jwt, start Redis, and run a net/http server that logs in, verifies, and logs out with ES256 JWTs in a few minutes.
en.architecture: One diagram of go-jwt layers: middleware, Create/Verify/refresh/Revoke, fingerprinting, cookies, PEM keys, and Redis state.
en.core-concepts: How go-jwt uses an ES256 Access Token, a SHA-256 Refresh ID, and a Redis JTI whitelist, including JWT claims and RefreshData fields.
en.verification: The nine checks Verify runs in order: revocation, signature, nbf/iat, Refresh ID and fingerprint binding, JTI whitelist, with failure codes.
en.refresh: How expired JWTs refresh transparently: Redis lock, CheckAuth, re-sign versus full refresh token rotation by MaxVersion and TTL, and 429 handling.
en.revocation: How Revoke logs out: cleared cookies, Redis revoke record for the Access Token, a 5-second Refresh ID grace window, and edge cases.
en.device-fingerprint: How go-jwt derives a SHA-256 device fingerprint from User-Agent and device ID, why curl needs X-Device-FP, and binding trade-offs.
en.middleware: Gin and net/http JWT middleware: failure responses, reading Auth from context, the "user" context key, and scope checks.
en.client-integration: Cookies and headers go-jwt reads and sets, plus browser, mobile, and API client setup including full-reissue cookies and 429 retries.
en.configuration: Config, Redis, Option, and Cookie fields with defaults: token lifetimes, cookie names, MaxVersion, RefreshTTL, and syslog logging.
en.key-management: ES256 key loading order, PKCS#8/PKIX format, P-256 requirement, OpenSSL commands, shared keys across instances, and rotation.
en.api-reference: Every exported go-jwt/core function, JWTAuth method, and type: New, Create, Verify, Revoke, middleware, JWTAuthResult, Auth.
en.error-codes: Every JWTAuthResult StatusCode and ErrorTag pair (400, 401, 429, 500) with its trigger, plus how to branch on tags.
en.redis-keys: The four Redis keys go-jwt writes (refresh, jti, lock, revoke), their TTLs, per-operation reads and writes, and the unlock script.
en.removed-api: Symbols removed from go-jwt by version, from v0.4.0 to the v1.0.3 move to the core subpackage, with replacements.

zh.home: Go JWT Token 驗證函式庫：Redis 管理 ES256 JWT 與 Refresh Token 輪替、撤銷、裝置綁定及 Gin 中介層，作者邱敬幃。
zh.getting-started: 安裝 go-jwt、啟動 Redis，幾分鐘內跑起以 ES256 JWT 登入、驗證與登出的 net/http 伺服器。
zh.architecture: 一張圖看懂 go-jwt 分層：中介層、Create／Verify／刷新／Revoke、裝置指紋、Cookie、金鑰與 Redis。
zh.core-concepts: go-jwt 如何組合 ES256 Access Token、SHA-256 Refresh ID 與 Redis JTI 白名單，以及 JWT claims。
zh.verification: Verify 依序執行的九項檢查：撤銷、簽章、nbf／iat、Refresh ID 與指紋綁定、JTI 白名單，以及各自的錯誤碼。
zh.refresh: JWT 過期如何透明刷新：Redis 鎖、CheckAuth、依 MaxVersion 與 TTL 決定重簽或 Refresh Token 輪替。
zh.revocation: Revoke 如何登出：清除 Cookie、寫入 Access Token 撤銷紀錄、Refresh ID 5 秒緩衝期與邊界情境。
zh.device-fingerprint: go-jwt 如何由 User-Agent 與裝置 ID 算出 SHA-256 指紋、curl 為何需要 X-Device-FP，以及綁定強度取捨。
zh.middleware: Gin 與 net/http 的 JWT 中介層：失敗回應、從 context 取出 Auth、"user" context key 與 scope 授權。
zh.client-integration: go-jwt 讀寫的 Cookie 與 header，以及瀏覽器、行動 App、API 客戶端的串接方式與 429 重送。
zh.configuration: Config、Redis、Option、Cookie 欄位與預設值：Token 有效期、Cookie 名稱、MaxVersion、RefreshTTL。
zh.key-management: ES256 金鑰載入順序、PKCS#8／PKIX 格式、P-256 限制、OpenSSL 指令、多實例共用金鑰與輪替。
zh.api-reference: go-jwt/core 所有匯出函式、方法與型別：New、Create、Verify、Revoke、中介層、JWTAuthResult。
zh.error-codes: JWTAuthResult 每組 StatusCode 與 ErrorTag（400、401、429、500）的觸發情境，以及依標籤分流的寫法。
zh.redis-keys: go-jwt 寫入的四種 Redis key（refresh、jti、lock、revoke）、TTL、各操作的讀寫與解鎖腳本。
zh.removed-api: go-jwt 歷次移除的符號，從 v0.4.0 到 v1.0.3 移至 core 子套件，附移除版本與替代做法。
